card.name: Dashes inside number ranges
card.fires_on: Dash or hyphen marks, and sometimes the digit right after a minus sign, in numeric ranges or tables, such as '(range: –' in drug interaction data or '150/-'.

modes.label: Range dash
modes.description: A dash or hyphen after 'range:' or between numbers in a result range.

modes.label: Dash in tables or lists
modes.description: A lone hyphen between numbers in a table of values or cycles.

modes.label: Minus-sign numbers
modes.description: A digit right after a minus sign in a list of numbers.

card.plain: It fires on the dash that stands between two numbers in a range or table.
